Definition: what place?; also (of time) when?; or (of means) how?
BiblicalUsage: In the Old Testament, ʼêyphôh is the word for what place?; also (of time) when?; or (of means) how?. In Judges 8:18, the text says "What manner of men [were they] whom ye slew at Tabor? And they answered." In 1 Samuel 19:22, the text says "Then went he also to Ramah."
TheologicalSignificance: Reading ʼêyphôh this way, I believe wisdom begins with fearing the Lord, and it shows in how we live, not just what we know. That is why I keep this word in mind when I read those passages — it carries more than its size suggests.
